notes: Both documents were delegates with the same three tiers. Main disagreements: policy type on 6 of 18 matched units (select-one P09 vs P04, misuse sentence P28 vs P36, tier-3 assumption P01 vs P29, clarity-of-expectations P09 vs P56, named levels P04 vs P05, task force P56 vs UNCOVERED); resolved by re-reading the text and choosing the type whose definition the sentence states (e.g. P28 because use is authorized and only missing attribution is called dishonesty). Actor, phase and modality splits were resolved from who the sentence binds and its wording. Coders also differed in unit granularity: A split detection and ethics concerns out; B merged them. I split them (one policy per unit). Kept 3 A-only units (detection, balanced perspective, ethics) and 2 B-only units (conditional 'we may use AI Writing tools', 'No Use' heading); dropped B-only syllabus-generator-up-to-date unit (not an AI policy statement).
